walkthroughs.body_html:
Programming Languages & IDEs — a core area of GCSE Computer Science.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Programming Languages & IDEs brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Programming Languages & IDEs.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Why is UDP used for live video streaming despite being unreliable?
